description_en: Upgrades the database version of a specified ApsaraDB SelectDB instance
description_zh: 升级指定云数据库SelectDB版实例的数据库版本
kebab_example: aliyun selectdb upgrade-db-instance-engine-version --db-instance-id selectdb-cn-7213cjv0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --engine-version 2.4 --switch-time-mode 1 --parallel-operation false --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeDBInstanceEngineVersion

parameters.description_en:
Upgrade method.

- If you do not specify this parameter, the system immediately upgrades the instance.
- If you set this parameter to 1, the system upgrades the instance during the maintenance window.
parameters.description_zh:
升级方式。

- 不填写代表立即升级。
- 填写1代表在可维护的时间段升级。
